issue.title: [Epic] Recording sync & cloud storage (R2)
issue.body:
### Summary

Epic tracking recording sync to R2 cloud storage on the **Expo SDK 56 CNG (Android-only) baseline**. The `recordings` schema on main is **already good** (TEXT PK, `bible_text_id` FK, `local_file_path`, `blob_key`, `sync_status`, `take_number`/`is_latest`, `idx_rec_pending`). The work is: fix integrity gaps in **related** tables, build a net-new upload worker on `expo-file-system`, extend the existing sync-status UI, and freeze the server contract. The junior handoff [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) `recordingSync.ts` (uses `@env` + `react-native-fs` + path coupling + non-matching columns) is referenced **only** as an anti-pattern.

**Verify pass (2026-07):** All sub-issues (#99–#102) still open. Blocked on #110 (migrations) and fluent-api PR #188 for #102. Recordings join fix is on main.

### Sub-issues
- [x] #99
- [x] #100
- [x] #101
- [x] #102

### Dependency ordering
1. **#110 (F2 migrations)** must land before **#99** schema changes.
2. **#99 (C1)** restores `chapter_assignments` FK/index (jointly with #103) and confirms recordings↔verse linkage.
3. **#100 (C2)** upload worker — needs A1 (#88 token), B1 (#94 file-system), and #98 repo helpers.
4. **#101 (C3)** UI — extends existing hooks/icons, consumes worker events.
5. **#102 (C4)** server contract — **blocked on [fluent-api PR #188](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/188)**; keep DevQA label.
- B (epic #116) must precede C — the worker uploads recorded files.

### Links
- Anti-pattern reference only (not merging): [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82)
- API: [fluent-api PR #188](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/188)
